theme: Opening-range and session-extreme breakouts — intraday breaks of a prior session/period high-low.

specs.name: ORBHighBreak
specs.rule: Long when Close crosses above HighestInRange(opening window); short on cross below LowestInRange
specs.hypothesis: After the first 30-60min sets the opening range, a close beyond it predicts positive forward intraday return in the break direction.
specs.economic_rationale: The opening auction concentrates overnight flow; clearing the initial band invites latecomers and stop-runs (Crabel ORB).
specs.orthogonality: Intraday clock-windowed level, not an indicator midline or MA cross.
specs.notes: INTRADAY ONLY. HHMM in SERVER time — calibrate to broker TZ. Time-bounded atoms (no period knob).

specs.name: ORBHighReclaim
specs.rule: Long when Close crosses back above SessionHigh of the morning window (shift 1)
specs.hypothesis: A close reclaiming the prior morning-session high after a pullback predicts afternoon continuation more than unbroken drift.
specs.economic_rationale: Reclaiming a known session extreme flushes faders' shorts; covering plus trend-followers sustain the move.
specs.orthogonality: Frozen session extreme (shift 1) vs the developing opening range of ORBHighBreak.
specs.notes: INTRADAY; SERVER-TZ guesses, calibrate. SessionHigh at shift 1 = prior closed session, no look-ahead.

specs.name: PrevDayHighBreak
specs.rule: Long when Close crosses above HighD (prior closed day high, shift 1); short below LowD
specs.hypothesis: Breaking the prior day's high predicts positive forward 1-3 day return more than bars inside the prior day's range.
specs.economic_rationale: PDH/PDL are universal references; clustered stops and breakout orders sit just beyond, so a clean break cascades.
specs.orthogonality: Calendar-day boundary level, orthogonal to rolling-N channels.
specs.source: Lukac/Brorsen/Irwin channel-breakout studies; documented PDH/PDL effect.
specs.notes: HighD/LowD at #Shift#=1 (shift 0 = developing day = look-ahead). Most useful on intraday TFs.

specs.name: PrevDayHighSweepFade
specs.rule: Short when Close crosses back below HighD (shift 1) after High exceeded it (liquidity sweep); long mirror on LowD reclaim
specs.hypothesis: Spiking above the prior-day high intrabar but CLOSING back below it yields negative forward 1-2 day return — the break failed.
specs.economic_rationale: Liquidity grab: price reaches above an obvious level to fill stops, then reverts once that liquidity is consumed.
specs.orthogonality: Same atoms as PrevDayHighBreak, opposite direction — false-break reversion vs continuation, opposite regimes.
specs.source: Crabel false-break / Williams trap; Connors reversion.
specs.notes: Cross-back-through HighD as the failed-break proxy (one clean cross). Read at shift 1. INTRADAY most useful.

specs.name: GapAndGoFade
specs.rule: Long when Close holds above prior-day high (gap that did not fill); short mirror below prior-day low
specs.hypothesis: Closing the bar holding above the prior-day high (unfilled gap) predicts positive forward intraday return vs a gap that closes back inside.
specs.economic_rationale: An unfilled gap above a reference level signals overnight repricing the market accepts — fresh equilibrium higher, momentum persists.
specs.orthogonality: Level-STATE (is_greater) holding condition vs the cross EVENT of PrevDayHighBreak.
specs.notes: HighD/LowD at shift 1. One clean level-state signal. INTRADAY. Pairs against PrevDayHighSweepFade (continuation vs reversion).

specs.name: PivotR1Break
specs.rule: Long when Close crosses above floor-pivot R1 (#Line#=R1); short below S1
specs.hypothesis: A close through R1 predicts continuation toward R2 over the session more than a bar stalling below R1.
specs.economic_rationale: Floor-trader pivots are mechanically derived and broadly watched; orders cluster at R1/S1, giving self-fulfilling follow-through.
specs.orthogonality: Multi-output pivot level from prior-session HLC — different reference geometry than session/day extremes or rolling channels.
specs.notes: Pivots multi-output: long #Line#=R1(1), short #Line#=S1(4). Session reset #StartHour#:#StartMinute# — calibrate. INTRADAY.

specs.name: PivotPPBias
specs.rule: Long-side filter: Close > daily pivot PP (#Line#=PP); short when Close < PP. Regime gate, not a trigger
specs.hypothesis: Price above PP biases forward intraday returns positive; the up-day rate above PP exceeds that below PP.
specs.economic_rationale: PP is the session's equilibrium proxy; above it = buyers control the auction, which tends to persist within the session.
specs.orthogonality: STATE filter on the central pivot, complementing the R1/S1 break TRIGGER (gate vs entry).
specs.notes: #Line#=PP(0). Directional filter slot, not standalone entry. Calibrate session reset. INTRADAY.

specs.name: PrevWeekRangeBreak
specs.rule: Long when Close crosses above HighW (prior closed week high, shift 1); short below LowW
specs.hypothesis: Breaking the prior week's high predicts positive forward return over following days more than bars inside the prior week's range.
specs.economic_rationale: Weekly extremes are swing/position-desk references; clearing them removes resting supply and triggers a slower, durable cascade.
specs.orthogonality: Higher-TF calendar level (week) than PrevDayHighBreak — same mechanism, slower horizon.
specs.source: Multi-TF channel-breakout; weekly-range Donchian on calendar weeks.
specs.notes: HighW/LowW at #Shift#=1 (shift 0 = developing week = look-ahead). Works intraday AND daily.
